carrier.description: the 5-chair: unit cells [b, b+1]^5 for b in {0,1}^5 except b = (1,1,1,1,1); i.e. [0,2]^5 minus [1,2]^5

facet_convention: facet (cell c, axis a, side s) is the unit facet between cell c and cell c + s e_a; outward normal s e_a; chart x in [-1/2,1/2]^4 on the tangent axes in increasing order, origin at the facet centre c + (1/2,...,1/2) + (s/2) e_a
key_rule: a key with orientation gamma = (perm p, signs s) in B_4 is act(gamma, K0 + xbar), act(gamma, x)_i = s_i x_{p_i}, on the chart; bump = raised outward by h, dent = the same polytope reflected into the tile (removed); its chart centre act(gamma, xbar) is a signed permutation of (1,2,3,4)/20 and determines gamma
name: T5 (sparse-key 5D chair, rule Lambda(1,2), S51/B_five) -- FINAL, height rescaled to 1/240 (S51/D_proof)

reference_key_K0.definition: K0 = convex hull of the base box prod_i [-w_i, w_i] (in the facet plane) and the apex (o, h) at normal height h

rescale_provenance.reason: PROOF.md hypothesis T5 via the sufficient bound: all face slopes <= 1/2 (h <= 1/(48(k+1)) for the COMMON key widths)
rescale_provenance.rule: every signed height h_s replaced by sign(h_s) * new_height; K0 apex height likewise; nothing else changed
